frozen.thesis: Collective intelligence from private conviction under quadratic cost, verified against ground truth
frozen.audience: Warwick - racing insider, NOT tech/crypto. Understands punters, tipsters, bookmakers, corporate boxes.

slides.title: Every Saturday...
slides.body:
Thousands study form.
Argue with mates.
Develop private convictions.

Then bet individually into a system
designed to take their money.

title.text:
Their collective intelligence
beats any tipster.

slides.subtitle:
But it's never captured.
Never aggregated.
Never returned.

slides.label: Australian wagering market, annually
slides.body:
Three operators control it.
Sportsbet. Ladbrokes. TAB.

Information extractors.

slides.title: Intelligence flows one way.
slides.body:
The punter commons existed.
Pubs. The track. WhatsApp groups.

Industrialised bookmaking enclosed it.

No venue aggregates it honestly
and returns it to its creators.

title.text:
What if the pub
could think?

slides.body:
Racing delivers objective truth
every thirty minutes.

No committee.
The horse crossed first.

"CERTAIN Horse 5 wins Race 3."
"THINK Horse 2 has a chance."
"Race 4? No idea."

Three conviction levels.
Every tipping platform treats them the same.

A budget forces honesty about
where you actually have an edge.

Cost grows as the square.

1 vote  =   1 credit
2 votes =   4 credits
3 votes =   9 credits
5 votes = 25 credits

Double conviction.
Four times the cost.

Prove something without revealing anything else.

"I'm in this community" — without saying who.

"I predicted Horse 5" — sealed envelope opened after.

"My strike rate is 34%" — without revealing identity.

Five mates in WhatsApp:
"We're all piling on Horse 3."

But any member can secretly change their vote.
The ringleader can't tell.

Rational move: silently defect, vote honestly.

Doesn't catch cartels.
Makes them impossible to coordinate.

Among Us. Blood on the Clocktower.

Night — secret actions.
Day — public discussion.

Some honest. Some lying.
Nobody knows who.

The drama is emergent.

slides.title: The Closed System
slides.body:
Ground Truth → exam for
  Conviction → priced by
    Quadratic Cost → protected by
      Sealed Envelopes → hardened by
        Anti-Collusion → experienced as
          Social Deduction → validated by
            Ground Truth ← loop closes

slides.title: The 30-Minute Cycle
slides.body:
NIGHT — Allocate. Private. Hidden.

DAWN — Race runs. Truth arrives. Credits settle.

DAY — Forensics. "Unusual pattern in Race 4."

DUSK — Discussion. Who called it?

↻ Repeat. 8–10 times per meeting.

subtitle.text: Not an aspiration. A mathematical property.

slides.title: THE GAME
slides.subtitle: What it feels like to play.

slides.title: A Saturday Inside
slides.body:
MORNING — Tip sheets. Study form. Allocate.

RACE 1 — Allocations close. Race runs. Settle.

BETWEEN — Forensics surface. Community discusses.

RACE 2 — Loop repeats. 8–10 times.

EVENING — Daily stats. Leaderboard moves.

cells.title: THE ANALYST
cells.body:
Studies form obsessively.
Lives for the leaderboard.
Proves they're the best.

cells.title: THE PUNTER
cells.body:
Hunches. Longshots.
Thrill of the unlikely call.
Finds overlays.

cells.title: THE SOCIALISER
cells.body:
Lives in chat.
Community IS the product.
Belonging over winning.

Hunts anomaly patterns.
Exposes manipulation.
The immune system.

title.text:
The Shark doesn't exist
on tipping platforms today.

slides.subtitle:
Social deduction creates the Shark.
Catching someone gaming is genuinely fun.

The Shark plays for free.

Your punters are at the track.
We built the boxes.

slides.title: Every Bookmaker Gets a Box
slides.body:
Same track. Same races.
Different box. Different brand.

Bookmakers don't build racecourses.
They lease boxes.

Marginal cost per box → near zero.

sidebar.text:
"Which box called
more winners?"

Sportsbet: 7 of 10.
Ladbrokes: 5.

That's content.
Tribal identity.

slides.title: THE MOAT
slides.subtitle: Five layers. Each reinforces the others.

slides.title: Five Layers Deep
slides.body:
1. THE ROOM
    People inside each box. Can't clone pub trust.

2. DATA
    Months of conviction-vs-truth. Can't fake.

3. MECHANISM
    12–18 months to replicate.

4. PERSONAL AI
    Co-evolved. Non-transferable.

5. CROSS-BOX VIEW
    Only the box-builder sees all boxes.
